recipes.title: Redirect feedback is a banner
recipes.summary: After a server round-trip / redirect, announce the outcome with a .msg banner at the top of the content.
needs: show the result of a form submit
show the result of saving a form
constraints: redirect flows only; in-place actions use the toast host
kinds exactly ok|warn|err
past tense and name the object

evidence.quote: Server / redirect → an `.msg` banner at the top of the content.

recipes.title: In-place feedback is a toast
recipes.summary: JS/fetch actions announce via toast() from the shared host; one toast at a time.
needs: show a success toast after an action
constraints: host it once per page (toasts aria-live)
no page-local toast markup, no query-param toasts

evidence.quote: In-place (JS / fetch) → `toast(msg, kind)` from `core/shell.js` … One toast at a time.

recipes.title: Entity delete is armed, two-step, in place
recipes.summary: Deleting a listed entity (rule, flow, classifier, template, chat, record) is a two-step armed action; never a confirm() dialog.
needs: remove an item from a list
constraints: first activation arms, second deletes
auto-disarm 4s / Escape / outside click
announce the result afterwards

evidence.quote: Deleting an entity listed in the UI … is a two-step, in-place action. No `confirm()` dialog, ever, for these.

recipes.title: High-stakes actions keep a native confirm()
recipes.summary: Irreversible, security-relevant, or multi-item actions confirm with a sentence naming the object and consequence.
needs: require a typed reason at the point of action
high-stakes confirmation with a required reason
constraints: native confirm() on the form; sentence names object + consequence
the listed set plus reason-bearing reject/decline decisions
when the rationale must be recorded, pair the confirm with a required, labelled textarea (native control); the reason surfaces in the history (component/tl)

evidence.quote: Actions that are irreversible, security-relevant, or affect more than the clicked item keep a native `confirm()`.

provenance.review_decision: cand/05-confirm-reason-extension REVISE -> applied, Option A (03-review required actions 1-4: 5th need, ingredients, guideline reconciliation)

recipes.title: Entity on/off is the switch, not a button
recipes.summary: Every boolean enable/disable of an entity uses .px-sw; verbs are Enable/Disable; the route announces the new state.
needs: turn a setting on or off
constraints: verbs Enable / Disable only (never Pause/Resume or On/Off)
auto-submit announces

evidence.quote: Use `.px-sw` for every boolean enable/disable of an entity.

recipes.title: Status is never colour-only
recipes.summary: State of an item is shown with a compact label/cell plus text (or icon); colour alone is prohibited.
needs: show the state of an item
show the state of a request or item
show the approval status of a record
constraints: pair colour with text or an icon
one status treatment per row cell

evidence.quote: Colour is never the only signal — pair it with text or an icon.

recipes.title: Empty areas use the empty anatomy
recipes.summary: Any list or card with nothing to show gets title + one line of reason + at most one CTA.
constraints: never a bare blank area or a bare 'failed'
specific reason + one recovery action

evidence.quote: `.empty` anatomy: optional icon, an `h4` title, one line of reason, and at most one CTA.

recipes.title: Bulk actions live in the selection bar
recipes.summary: Batch operations on selected rows appear in .bulkbar only with a selection; triggers in .tactions.
constraints: appears only with a selection
announce the count/result afterwards

evidence.quote: Bulk actions live in `.bulkbar`, which appears only with a selection.

recipes.title: Editors end in a save bar
recipes.summary: Editors (forms that configure something) end in .savebar with primary Save plus Cancel; Cancel is the way out.
needs: edit form with save and cancel
constraints: Server-side validation renders at the top of the form and receives focus
settings cards keep scoped partial saves

evidence.quote: Editors end in a `.savebar`: primary **Save \<thing>** plus **Cancel**.

recipes.title: Row actions: inline + menu variants
recipes.summary: Record actions appear on hover/focus with .ra-inline for the key few and a details.menu for the rest; touch shows the menu.
needs: the chevron that reveals actions for a single row
reveal the actions for one row
constraints: sentence case; destructive item is menu-item danger arm-del
every .rowacts ships both variants

evidence.quote: Desktop: relevant actions inline with `.ra-inline`; the rest in a `details.menu` with `.ra-menu` and a `.menu-pop`.

tests: authority: dispute query -> COMPOSE recipe/row-actions 20.0; bulk-actions needs intact

recipes.title: Pages open with a page head
recipes.summary: Page title + one-line description + actions; hierarchy levels are not skipped.
constraints: don't shrink a page title to fit a long subject; let it wrap
section headings and card headings mark different scopes

evidence.quote: Don't shrink a page title with inline font-size to fit a long subject — let it wrap at --fs-page-title.

recipes.title: Modal tasks use the native dialog
recipes.summary: Popups/modals are built on the native dialog element (.dlg), with static-backdrop when closing must be deliberate.
constraints: autofocus the first meaningful control
Esc/backdrop behavior deliberate

recipes.title: Long lists paginate with numbered pager
recipes.summary: Long result sets page with the numbered pager plus page-size control; phone view trims chrome.

recipes.title: Copy affordances use the shared helper
recipes.summary: Copy-to-clipboard goes through cp()/.copy so fallback and labelling stay consistent.
constraints: never call navigator.clipboard from page code

evidence.quote: Never call `navigator.clipboard` from page code — the helper owns the fallback and the confirmation labelling.

recipes.title: Filtering a list is a chip row over the table
recipes.summary: Narrow a list with a row of chips above the table; chips are selection tokens, not status badges.
constraints: chips mark selection, badges mark status — do not conflate
active filters stay visible with a clear affordance

recipes.title: Assign one person to a small fixed set
recipes.summary: A labelled single-select (native select) beside one assign action; the outcome announces the new assignee by name.
needs: assign a reviewer to a request
assign an owner to a record
choose one reviewer in a fixed list
pick a person in a small fixed list
single select of a fixed set of options
choose an assignee for a record
constraints: native select for small fixed sets; component/cb only when the set is large or needs filtering
the control is always labelled and the submit announces the new value by name
if the assign is handled in place (fetch), the outcome uses recipe/feedback-inplace instead of the redirect banner
degrades without JS

evidence.quote: Fallback/local solution used: fallback/native-control in all four runs - a token-conformant native <select> + submit button

provenance.review_decision: cand/03-recipe-assign-picker REVISE -> applied (03-review required actions 1-4: single feedback ingredient, from-leak removed, criterion rewritten)

recipes.title: Long-running background work shows determinate progress
recipes.summary: Compose the progress bar with a state badge, a scanned/total readout and text for queued/running/stalled/failed/done; failures name the reason and offer retry; updates arrive by JSON polling.
needs: show the progress of a background job
determinate progress for a long-running operation
show how far a scan has come
background job status with percent complete
constraints: state is always text + colour (recipe/status-with-text)
queued and done are labelled states too (same text+colour treatment; a completed bar is not left unlabelled)
stalled is detected by the count not advancing and shown as a text label
failed names the reason and offers a retry action
aria-valuenow updates on the bar; state changes are announced via an aria-live region on the status line (or the shared toast host)
poll JSON; no page reloads

evidence.quote: Fallback/local solution used: fallback/plain-content in all three - composing .progress + .spinner + .badge on a system card, plus JSON polling and stall detection

provenance.review_decision: cand/04-recipe-job-progress REVISE -> applied (03-review required actions 1-4: btn ingredient, re-run need, queued/done coverage, criterion rewritten)
